context: Tests whether the agent produces a Conventional Commits title with a breaking-change marker, writes a description that leads with what/why in present tense without echoing the title, uses the correct closing keyword for the linked issue, and constructs the gh pr edit command correctly with --body-file.

checklist.name: Breaking change marker
checklist.description: The title in `pr-title.md` contains `!` after the scope or type to signal a breaking change (e.g. `feat(auth)!:` or `fix!:`)

checklist.name: Conventional Commits format
checklist.description: The title in `pr-title.md` follows the pattern `<type>(<scope>): <subject>` or `<type>: <subject>` — a recognized type keyword followed by an optional parenthesised scope, a colon, and a subject

checklist.name: Title style rules
checklist.description: The title in `pr-title.md` is imperative mood, all-lowercase type/scope/subject, has no trailing period, and is 72 characters or fewer in total length

checklist.name: Title absent from body
checklist.description: The description in `pr-description.md` does NOT contain the title text from `pr-title.md` verbatim (title is not repeated in the body)

checklist.name: What and why lead
checklist.description: The description in `pr-description.md` opens with sections explaining WHAT changed and WHY (the motivation), not how the implementation was done

checklist.name: Present tense verbs
checklist.description: The description in `pr-description.md` uses present tense verbs throughout (e.g. 'Replaces', 'Removes', 'Adds', 'Requires') rather than past tense ('Replaced', 'Removed', 'Added')

checklist.name: Closing keyword for issue #42
checklist.description: The description in `pr-description.md` contains a closing keyword linking issue 42: one of `Closes #42`, `Fixes #42`, or `Resolves #42` (not `Related to #42`)

checklist.name: No empty related-issues section
checklist.description: The description in `pr-description.md` does NOT contain a `## Related issues` (or equivalent) section heading with no content beneath it

checklist.name: Uses --body-file with temp path
checklist.description: `update-pr.sh` passes `--body-file` to `gh pr edit` with a path under `/tmp/` (e.g. `/tmp/pr-description-73.md`), rather than using `--body` with inline text

checklist.name: Single gh pr edit call
checklist.description: `update-pr.sh` applies both the title (`--title`) and the body (`--body-file`) in a single `gh pr edit 73` command, not two separate calls
